verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official `create-playcanvas` CLI for scaffolding Vite/TypeScript projects, which an AI agent could invoke, but the docs describe it purely as a project scaffolder with no explicit AI-native/agentic features (non-interactive flags, scripting API, automation hooks) and no independent confirmation of agent usage. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI flags/JSON output for automation, evidence of AI-agent usage, and any tie-in with the MCP server workflow.
